headline: In Uzbekistan, salaries will be able to be received on any bank card. How will the new system work?
summary: Uzbek employees will be able to choose any bank to receive wages, bonuses and other payments by submitting card details to accounting. The central bank's new system initially covers the private sector.
why: The central bank sets payment infrastructure rules that shape how banks compete for deposits and payroll business. Changes affect banking revenues and the pace of digital payments.
original_headline: O‘zbekistonda ish haqini istalgan bank kartasiga olish mumkin bo‘ladi. Yangi tizim qanday ishlaydi?
